script:
This man killed over 500 soldiers in 100 days.
They called him the White Death.
Finland. The Winter War. Minus forty degrees.
The Soviet Union attacks with everything — tanks, artillery, thousands of men.
And somewhere in the snow… lies one man.
Simo Häyhä.
No scope. No modern gear.
Just a rifle, white camo, and total silence.
He packs snow in his mouth so his breath won't give him away.
He doesn't move. He waits.
And every time a Soviet soldier spots him — it's already too late.
The Red Army wants him dead.
They shell entire forests. They send counter-snipers.
But Häyhä just vanishes into the white.
Then a round hits him in the face and tears it open.
He survives.
When he finally wakes from the coma — the war is over.
And his name is already a legend.
The White Death.
title: The Great Emu War
